_approach: Ride-cymbal-led hypnotic techno in the vein of Phase Fatale and the dark, cinematic techno Attack's dissection describes: the ride plays a steady loud/soft 8th pulse as the main engine (no closed hat racing underneath it), a closed hat sits on the third 16th of each quarter, an open hat answers on selected beats in bar 2, and the snare and a shaker trade a call-and-response figure that only appears in the second bar. Straight time (no swing) so the ride reads as hypnotic repetition rather than shuffle.
